name: dashtro
description: Self-hosted headless CMS platform with a unified Studio for managing content, collections, and documents across multiple projects.
author: Atharva Devasthali

scripts.dev:build: DB_TYPE=sqlite docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && DB_TYPE=sqlite docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
scripts.dev:postgres: DB_TYPE=postgres docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile postgres up --build
scripts.dev:postgres:build: DB_TYPE=postgres docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile postgres build --no-cache && DB_TYPE=postgres docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile postgres up
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:mcp-python && npm run test:mcp
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run precommit:changesets
